language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially rests on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around the handle and lifts the spoon (frames 92–120, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it toward the open drawer. It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 220–225 (image and wrist_image). The spoon remains inside while the empty gripper withdraws through frame 249 (image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
